birds.why: everyone gets the bonus – good only if you gain more from it than they do

birds.name: Himalayan Monal
birds.power: All players gain 1 seed from the supply. You also lay 1 egg.
birds.why: everyone gets the bonus – good only if you gain more from it than they do

birds.name: Hooded Crow
birds.power: Choose 1 other player. For each action cube on their grassland, tuck 1 card from your hand behind this bird, then draw an equal number of card.
birds.why: you and one opponent both gain – small edge

birds.name: Hooded Merganser
birds.power: Repeat 1 predator power in this habitat.
birds.why: repeats a predator – good only in a predator row

birds.name: Hooded Warbler
birds.why: no power – it is only worth its points, so play it late

birds.name: Horned Lark
birds.power: When another player plays a bird in their grassland, tuck 1 card from your hand behind this bird.
birds.why: gains free food whenever someone plays a bird in that habitat

birds.name: Horsfield's Bronze-Cuckoo
birds.power: When another player takes the “lay eggs” action, lay 1 egg on a bird with a wingspan less than 30cm.
birds.why: lays free eggs on other players’ turns – almost everyone lays eggs, so it fires again and again

birds.name: Horsfield's Bushlark
birds.power: Discard 1 seed. If you do, lay up to 2 egg on this bird.
birds.why: food into eggs – OK when food is plentiful

birds.name: House Crow
birds.power: You may cache 1 wild from your supply on each bird in this row.
birds.why: a point from cached food most activations

birds.name: House Finch
birds.power: Tuck 1 card from your hand behind this bird. If you do, draw 1 card.
birds.why: flocking: 1 point per activation (tucked card) PLUS a card, egg or food back

birds.name: House Sparrow
birds.power: Discard up to 5 seed from your supply. For each, tuck 1 card from the deck behind this bird.
birds.why: converts spare food into points or cards – good late when food has nothing left to buy

birds.name: House Wren
birds.power: Play an additional bird in this bird's habitat. Pay its normal cost.
birds.why: plays a second bird for one action – a whole extra turn early in the game

birds.name: Iberian Magpie
birds.power: Lay 2 egg on each adjacent bird with a platform nest.
birds.why: extra eggs – points and bird costs

birds.name: Ibisbill
birds.power: All players draw 1 card from the deck and gain 1 invertebrate from the supply. You draw 1 additional card from the deck.
birds.why: everyone gets the bonus – good only if you gain more from it than they do

birds.name: Inca Dove
birds.power: Lay 1 egg on each of your birds with a platform nest.
birds.why: several eggs at once – big when played late on a full board

birds.name: Indian Courser
birds.power: When another player takes the “draw cards” action, draw 1 card from the tray at the end of their turn. If there are no cards in the tray then, refill the tray first.
birds.why: fires on other players’ turns – free value while you wait

birds.name: Indian Paradise Flycatcher
birds.power: All players gain 1 wild from the supply, lay 1 egg on any bird, and draw 1 card from the deck. You may do all 3 a second time.
birds.why: everyone gets the bonus – good only if you gain more from it than they do

birds.name: Indian Peafowl
birds.power: All players draw 2 card from the deck. You draw 1 additional card.
birds.why: everyone gets the bonus – good only if you gain more from it than they do

birds.name: Indian Vulture
birds.power: Copy one bonus card of the player on your right, as if it were your own (score it based on your own birds).
birds.why: game end power – counts once, play it in round 4

birds.name: Indigo Bunting
birds.power: Gain 1 invertebrate or fruit from the birdfeeder, if available.
birds.why: extra food from the feeder – only when the right die is there

birds.name: Italian Sparrow
birds.power: If this bird has 2–3 egg on it, lay 1 egg on this bird.
birds.why: extra eggs – points and bird costs

birds.name: Ivory Gull
birds.power: Choose a food in the cost of the card on top of the discard pile. Cache 1 of that food from the supply on this bird. You may spend food on this bird when activating a bird power.
birds.why: a point from cached food most activations

birds.name: Juniper Titmouse
birds.power: Cache 1 seed from the supply on this bird.
birds.why: a sure point every activation, no dice needed

birds.name: Kea
birds.power: Draw 1 bonus card. You may discard any number of wild to draw that many additional bonus cards. Keep 1 of the cards you drew and discard the rest.
birds.why: an extra bonus card – often 3-6 points, but slow

birds.name: Kelp Gull
birds.power: Discard any number of wild to draw that many card.
birds.why: converts spare food into points or cards – good late when food has nothing left to buy

birds.name: Kererū
birds.power: If the player to your left has a nectar in their personal supply, gain 1 nectar from the general supply.
birds.why: free food or a point when a neighbour holds that food – fires often

birds.name: Killdeer
birds.power: Discard 1 egg to draw 2 card.
birds.why: turns 1 egg into 2 cards every activation – starts the best card/tuck engine

birds.name: King Eider
birds.power: If you have fewer than 4 wild in your supply, gain 1 die from the birdfeeder.
birds.why: extra food most activations

birds.name: King Rail
birds.power: Draw 2 new bonus cards and keep 1.
birds.why: an extra bonus card – often 3-6 points, but slow

birds.name: Korimako
birds.power: Discard any number of rodent to gain that many nectar from the supply.
birds.why: converts spare food into points or cards – good late when food has nothing left to buy

birds.name: Kākāpō
birds.power: Draw 4 bonus cards, keep 1, and discard the other 3.
birds.why: game end power – counts once, play it in round 4

birds.name: Large-Billed Crow
birds.power: Cache 1 wild from your supply on any bird. If you do, you may tuck 1 card from your hand behind this bird.
birds.why: a point from a tucked card most activations

birds.name: Laughing Gull

birds.why: fires on other players’ turns – free value while you wait

birds.name: Lazuli Bunting

birds.why: everyone gets the bonus – good only if you gain more from it than they do

birds.why: everyone gets the bonus – good only if you gain more from it than they do

birds.name: Lesser Prairie-Chicken
birds.power: Draw 2 new bonus cards. Keep 1 and reveal the other. All players score the revealed bonus card at game end.
birds.why: everyone gets the bonus – good only if you gain more from it than they do

birds.name: Lesser Spotted Woodpecker
birds.power: Discard 1 invertebrate to lay 2 egg on this bird.
birds.why: extra eggs – points and bird costs

birds.power: Choose a habitat with no egg. Lay 1 egg on each bird in that habitat.
birds.why: many eggs or points once per round for free

birds.name: Lewin's Honeyeater
birds.power: Choose 1 other player. You both gain 1 nectar from the supply.
birds.why: you and one opponent both gain – small edge

birds.power: If this bird is to the right of all other birds in its habitat, move it to another habitat.
birds.why: moves itself to another habitat – fiddly and slow

birds.name: Little Bustard
birds.power: Draw 1 new bonus card. Then gain 1 card or lay 1 egg on any bird.
birds.why: an extra bonus card – often 3-6 points, but slow

birds.name: Little Egret
birds.power: Draw 1 card from the deck and add it to your hand. All other players draw 1 card from the deck and keep it if it can live in wetland.
birds.why: extra cards

birds.name: Little Grebe
birds.power: For each bird in this column with an egg on it, draw 1 card. Keep 1 and discard the rest.
birds.why: extra cards

birds.name: Little Owl
birds.power: Steal 1 rodent from another player's supply and cache it on this bird. They gain 1 die from the birdfeeder.
birds.why: takes food from an opponent (they get a die back) – fine, not great

birds.power: Draw and discard 5 card from the deck. For each fish in their food costs, cache 1 fish from the supply on this bird.
birds.why: random fish points – some activations give 3, some 0

birds.name: Little Pied Cormorant
birds.power: Lay 1 egg on each of your birds with a platform nest, including this one.
birds.why: several eggs at once – big when played late on a full board

birds.name: Little Ringed Plover
birds.power: Discard 1 card from your hand. If you do, lay 1 egg on this bird.
birds.why: extra eggs – points and bird costs

birds.power: When another player takes the “gain food” action, if they gain any number of rodent, cache 1 rodent from the supply on this bird.
birds.why: free food on other players’ turns – steady, but the birdfeeder may be empty

birds.name: Long-Tailed Cuckoo
birds.power: When another player takes the “lay eggs” action, lay 1 egg on another bird in this row.
birds.why: lays free eggs on other players’ turns – almost everyone lays eggs, so it fires again and again

birds.power: Place this bird sideways, so that it covers 2 forest spaces. Pay the lower egg cost.
birds.why: takes two spaces – fewer birds in that row

birds.power: Up to 3 times, draw 1 card from the deck. When you stop, if the total point value is less than 6, tuck all drawn cards behind this bird. Otherwise discard them.
birds.why: a dice or card gamble – sometimes big, often nothing

birds.power: Give 1 bonus card to another player. If you do, draw 2 new bonus cards and lay 1 egg on this bird.
birds.why: an extra bonus card – often 3-6 points, but slow

birds.why: game end power – counts once, play it in round 4

birds.why: tucks for a point, but every player gets food too

birds.name: Mallard
birds.power: Draw 1 card.
birds.why: one extra card per activation – small

birds.name: Malleefowl
birds.power: Lay 1 egg on each of your birds with a ground nest, including this one.
birds.why: several eggs at once – big when played late on a full board

birds.name: Mandarin Duck
birds.power: Draw 5 card from the deck. Add 1 to your hand, tuck 1 behind this bird, give 1 to another player, and discard the rest.
birds.why: tucks for a point AND gives a card, food or egg back

birds.name: Maned Duck

birds.why: up to 3 points per activation and refills your hand

birds.why: a point from a tucked card most activations

birds.why: everyone gets the bonus – good only if you gain more from it than they do

birds.why: copies another power – as good as the power it copies

birds.why: rerolls the feeder to get the food you need

birds.name: Meadow Pipit
birds.power: All players lay 1 egg on each of their birds with a ground nest.
birds.why: everyone gets the bonus – good only if you gain more from it than they do

birds.name: Mediterranean Shearwater

birds.why: an extra bonus card – often 3-6 points, but slow

birds.name: Merlin
birds.power: When another player tucks a card behind a bird with a flocking power, tuck 1 card from the deck behind this bird.

birds.name: Mississippi Kite
birds.power: Roll all dice not in birdfeeder. If any are rodent, cache 1 rodent from the supply on this bird.
birds.why: dice-roll hunter: unreliable, and weak when few dice are outside the feeder

birds.name: Mistletoebird
birds.power: Gain 1 fruit from the supply, or discard 1 fruit to gain 1 nectar from the supply.
birds.why: a guaranteed food every activation

birds.name: Moltoni's Warbler
birds.power: If you used all 4 types of actions this round, play another bird. Pay its normal food and egg cost.
birds.why: a free extra bird each round, but only if you used all 4 actions

birds.name: Montagu's Harrier
birds.power: Instead of paying any costs, you may play this bird on top of another bird on your player mat. Discard any eggs and food from that bird. It becomes a tucked card.
birds.why: replaces a weak bird for free – lets you upgrade a full row

birds.name: Mountain Bluebird
birds.power: Play an additional bird in your grassland. Pay its normal cost.
birds.why: plays a second bird for one action – a whole extra turn early in the game

birds.name: Mountain Chickadee
birds.power: Cache 1 seed from the supply on this bird.
birds.why: a sure point every activation, no dice needed

birds.name: Mountain Quail

birds.why: rerolls the feeder to get the food you need

birds.name: Mourning Dove
birds.power: Lay 1 egg on this bird.
birds.why: an extra egg every activation, but only on itself

birds.name: Musk Duck
birds.power: Draw 1 face-up card from the tray with a ground or star nest. You may reset or refill the tray before doing so.
birds.why: picks a card you want from the tray

birds.name: Mute Swan
birds.power: Choose 1-3 birds in your wetland. Tuck 1 card from your hand behind each. If you tuck at least 1 card, draw 1 card.
birds.why: tucks behind several birds at once – many points from one activation if you have cards

birds.name: New Holland Honeyeater
birds.power: Gain 1 nectar from the birdfeeder, if there is one.
birds.why: extra food from the feeder – only when the right die is there

birds.name: New Zealand Dabchick
birds.power: Draw 3 card from the deck. Keep 1 of them, place 1 of them on the top of the deck, and discard the third.
birds.why: extra cards

birds.name: New Zealand Fairy Tern
birds.power: Discard up to 3 bonus cards. For each, cache 3 fish from the supply on this bird. Then draw 1 new bonus card.
birds.why: an extra bonus card – often 3-6 points, but slow

birds.name: New Zealand Falcon
birds.power: Tuck 1 bird with wingspan less than 65 cm from your hand behind this bird. If you do, cache 1 rodent from the supply on this bird.
birds.why: a point from a tucked card most activations

birds.name: New Zealand Rock Wren
birds.power: Draw 1 new bonus card. Up to 2 times, you may discard 1 bonus card to draw 1 new bonus card.
birds.why: an extra bonus card – often 3-6 points, but slow

birds.name: New Zealand Scaup
birds.power: Draw 1 card from the deck. If it has invertebrate in its food cost, discard it and gain 1 invertebrate from the supply. Otherwise, tuck it behind this bird.
birds.why: a point from a tucked card most activations

birds.name: Nicobar Pigeon
birds.power: Tuck up to 5 card from your hand behind this bird.
birds.why: several points from tucked cards at once

birds.name: Noisy Miner
birds.power: Tuck 1 card from your hand behind this bird. If you do, lay up to 2 egg on this bird. All other players may lay 1 egg.
birds.why: flocking: 1 point per activation (tucked card) PLUS a card, egg or food back

birds.name: North Island Brown Kiwi
birds.power: Discard a bonus card. If you do, draw 4 bonus cards, keep 2, and discard the other 2.
birds.why: an extra bonus card – often 3-6 points, but slow

birds.name: North Island Kōkako
birds.power: You may reset the birdfeeder. Then gain 1 fruit or nectar from the birdfeeder, if available.
birds.why: a niche power

birds.name: Northern Bobwhite
birds.power: Lay 1 egg on this bird.
birds.why: an extra egg every activation, but only on itself

birds.name: Northern Cardinal
birds.power: Gain 1 fruit from the supply.
birds.why: a guaranteed food every activation, no dice needed

birds.name: Northern Flicker
birds.power: Gain all invertebrate that are in the birdfeeder.
birds.why: empties the feeder for you – strong when it holds several of one food

birds.name: Northern Gannet

birds.why: dice-roll hunter: unreliable, and weak when few dice are outside the feeder

birds.name: Northern Goshawk

birds.why: can be paid with cards instead of food – easy to play

birds.name: Northern Harrier
birds.power: Look at a card from the deck. If less than 75cm, tuck it behind this bird. If not, discard it.
birds.why: predator: free point when the drawn bird is under 75 cm – succeeds most of the time

birds.name: Northern Mockingbird

birds.why: copies your best brown power in the row – doubles an engine

birds.name: Northern Pintail

birds.why: tucks for a point AND gives a card, food or egg back

birds.name: Northern Saw-Whet Owl

birds.why: dice-roll hunter: unreliable, and weak when few dice are outside the feeder

birds.power: All players draw 1 card from the deck.
birds.why: everyone gets the bonus – good only if you gain more from it than they do

birds.why: a dice or card gamble – sometimes big, often nothing

birds.power: Lay 1 egg on each of your birds with a ground nest, including this one.
birds.why: several eggs at once – big when played late on a full board

birds.power: Activate the “When Activated” (brown) powers of all of your other predator.

birds.why: a point from cached food most activations

birds.name: Osprey

birds.why: everyone gets the bonus – good only if you gain more from it than they do

birds.name: Ovenbird
birds.power: When another player plays a bird with a star nest, lay 1 egg on a bird with a star nest.
birds.why: fires on other players’ turns – free value while you wait

birds.why: extra eggs – points and bird costs

birds.power: Tuck 1 card from your hand behind this bird. For each fish in the tucked bird’s food cost, cache 1 fish from the supply on this bird.
birds.why: a point from a tucked card most activations

birds.power: Draw 2 new bonus cards and keep 1.
birds.why: an extra bonus card – often 3-6 points, but slow

birds.power: Gain 1 invertebrate from the supply.
birds.why: a guaranteed food every activation, no dice needed

birds.why: extra eggs – points and bird costs

birds.why: copies another power – as good as the power it copies

birds.name: Pileated Woodpecker
birds.power: All players lay 1 egg on any 1 cavity bird. You may lay 1 egg on 1 additional cavity bird.
birds.why: everyone gets the bonus – good only if you gain more from it than they do

birds.name: Pine Grosbeak
birds.power: If fewer than 2 seed are cached on this bird, cache 2 seed from the supply on this bird. At any time, you may spend seed cached on this bird.
birds.why: a point from cached food most activations

birds.why: flocking: 1 point per activation (tucked card) PLUS a card, egg or food back
